title.narrative: Strengthening civil society participation in democracy through effective, inclusive, good governance reform and oversight

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the project is to build a more democratic, inclusive, gender and culturally sensitive good governance and public accountability architecture in Belize. The Action will seek to achieve two main outcomes:

 

1.     Strengthened local civil society organizations¿ capacities for developing, advocating for, and monitoring national constitutional reforms on issues such as: campaign financing, public disclosure, public contracts, witness protection, civil assets recovery and other public accountability measures,

 

2.     2. An effective, modern national civil society good governance policy and legislative framework that mainstreams human rights, gender issues, environmental rights, youth empowerment, inclusion of LGBTQ rights, indigenous communities, persons with diverse abilities and digital innovation.

 

The project will engage through capacity development and other activities at least 25 local environmental and social sector CSOs representing women, environmental groups, human rights organisations, indigenous populations, LGBTQ populations, older persons, youths and persons with diverse abilities. This will allow diverse populations, including vulnerable groups to influence national public policy, which is critical to ensuring equitable access to public resources, the integration of a human rights-based approach to good governance and public accountability.

The project will include financial support to third parties, with a focus on local civil society organizations.

The proposed contract is to be awarded to Belize Audubon Society who will implement the action with its co-applicant Belize Network of NGOs.
